description: Mock class definitions for various interfaces related to HDMI CEC and system audio components, used for unit testing.

classes.name: LibCCECImplMock
classes.description: Mock implementation of the LibCCECImpl interface for testing HDMI CEC functionalities.

classes.name: SystemAudioStatusImplMock
classes.description: Mock implementation of the SystemAudioStatusImpl interface for testing system audio status features.

classes.name: AudioStatusImplMock
classes.description: Mock implementation of the AudioStatusImpl interface for testing audio status behaviors.

classes.name: PowerStatusImplMock
classes.description: Mock implementation of the PowerStatusImpl interface for testing power status handling.

classes.name: AbortReasonImplMock
classes.description: Mock implementation of the AbortReasonImpl interface for testing abort reasons in HDMI CEC.

classes.name: ShortAudioDescriptorImplMock
classes.description: Mock implementation of the ShortAudioDescriptorImpl interface for testing audio descriptor retrieval.

classes.name: ConnectionImplMock
classes.description: Mock implementation of the ConnectionImpl interface for testing connection behaviors.

classes.name: LogicalAddressImplMock
classes.description: Mock implementation of the LogicalAddressImpl interface for testing logical address functionalities.

classes.name: MessageEncoderMock
classes.description: Mock implementation of the MessageEncoderImpl for testing message encoding.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Mocked method to initialize the HDMI CEC or related components.

methods.name: term
methods.description: Mocked method to terminate the HDMI CEC component.

methods.name: getPhysicalAddress
methods.description: Mocked method to retrieve the physical address.

methods.name: addLogicalAddress
methods.description: Mocked method to add a logical address.

methods.name: getLogicalAddress
methods.description: Mocked method to get logical address.

methods.name: toInt
methods.description: Convert status or reason objects to integer representation.

methods.name: sendToAsync
methods.description: Send a frame asynchronously to a logical address.

methods.name: sendTo
methods.description: Send a frame to a logical address, possibly with timeout.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Get the type of logical address.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encode data block or user control into a CEC frame.
